name: s01-birth-and-division
question:
Pack the simulated whole-cell molecular state into a 3D cell at ~10 s
(post-equilibration birth) and right before division, so the Parsimony Viewer
can show both declared-time snapshots for this study.
conclusion:
RECONCILED 2026-07-27 (hardening). The pack pipeline previously ran end-to-end
(seed 0, relax=true, division reached) on a newer toolchain and reportedly
produced two loadable snapshots:
  - initial (t ≈ 10 s):    287,013 placed instances (~314k molecules, 46 species)
  - pre-division:          552,450 placed instances (~519k molecules, 46 species)
with content growing ~1.7-1.9x birth -> division at conserved composition and a
~1.5x envelope elongation — the rod-shaped growth expected of a dividing cell.

HOWEVER these numbers are NOT currently reproducible or verifiable in the
canonical environment, and were NOT re-derived by this hardening:
  * The ~90-180 MB pack artifacts were never committed — nothing on disk to
    check the numbers against (verified: workspace/studies/s01-birth-and-division/
    has only study.yaml; no viz/3d/).
  * The 3D pack cannot be produced here: pbg-parsimony is pinned to a moving
    `branch = "main"` and the installed editable checkout is stale — it lacks the
    `Ingredient(compartment=...)`, `build_pack(envelope=...)`, and multi-chromosome
    `Chromosome(...)` API that v2ecoli/structural/build.py requires (4 structural
    tests RED on canonical main for this reason) — and the `parsimony` mesh/pack
    binary is absent from the machine entirely.

What IS verified in the canonical env (green today, no parsimony binary needed):
  * Snapshot scheduling: both declared snapshots fire exactly once at their
    declared times / at division_time (tests/test_pack_step.py — green).
  * Count conservation at the selection layer: v2ecoli's counts -> ingredient
    selection conserves every selected species' count exactly, caps auto-
    expansion at top_n, and is deterministic
    (tests/structural/test_s01_acceptance_gate.py::test_selection_layer... — green).

The end-to-end pack gate (both snapshots written, placed-vs-requested
conservation, no over-pack, birth->division growth direction) is now DEFINED and
implemented (v2ecoli/structural/acceptance.py + the artifact test) but SKIPS
(not falsely passes) until a real pack is produced with a pinned toolchain.
See decisions_needed / followups on the investigation to unblock reproduction.

behavior_tests.name: snapshot-scheduling-fires-once-at-declared-times
behavior_tests.description: Each declared snapshot ("initial" at a fixed sim-time, "pre-division" at the chromosome's scheduled division_time) fires exactly once, at/after its target, within epsilon_s, and skips (without marking fired) when 'shape' has no volume yet. Reproducible with installed deps (no parsimony binary).

behavior_tests.name: selection-layer-conserves-counts
behavior_tests.description: v2ecoli's counts -> ingredient selection (build.select_ingredients) conserves every selected species' count EXACTLY (0 mismatches), caps auto-expanded monomers at top_n, and is deterministic. Verified via a permissive Ingredient shim so it does not depend on the stale installed pbg_parsimony API. This is the reproducible core of "packed counts conserve the simulation's counts".

behavior_tests.name: both-snapshots-written
behavior_tests.description: A real run writes BOTH snapshots' pack.json + meta.json + recipe under <study>/viz/3d, each with a non-empty 'placements' array. Skipped (never falsely passed) while the pack toolchain is absent.

behavior_tests.name: count-conservation-placed-vs-requested
behavior_tests.description: Per snapshot, the number of PLACED instances is within [0.80, 1.0] of the requested (scaled) count summed over ingredients — i.e. the packer drops at most ~20% for steric feasibility and never duplicates. Band is provisional; calibrate against the first real pack.

behavior_tests.name: no-overpack
behavior_tests.description: Placed instances never exceed requested (placed/requested <= 1.0) — a direct "no >100% packing / no gross steric overlap / no duplication" physical-plausibility floor.

behavior_tests.name: growth-direction-birth-to-division
behavior_tests.description: Pre-division has MORE placed instances than birth, the SAME ingredient-id set (conserved composition — growth is scaling-up, not a compositional shift), and a MORE elongated envelope (capsule aspect ratio increases). Encodes the study's biological reading as a testable check.
